high_level_description: This image is the cover of Vogue Russia magazine from May 2019. The central figure is a woman with long, dark hair styled in loose waves. She has a striking appearance with bold red lipstick and dramatic makeup that accentuates her eyes. Her expression is serious and direct, looking straight at the camera. She is wearing a stylish outfit that includes a brown leather jacket with a high collar and a transparent, sheer overlay. The jacket features a zipper running down the front, adding a modern and edgy touch to the look.
